description: This file contains unit tests for Cron scheduling and payload encoding/decoding, including functions to create test CronJob instances, and test cases for serialization, deserialization, and response parsing in the Cron scheduling system.

classes.name: CronModelsTests
classes.description: A collection of test functions for Cron job models, schedules, and payloads.

methods.name: makeCronJob
methods.description: Helper method to create a CronJob instance with specified parameters for testing purposes.

methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of 'at' type schedules.

methods.description: Tests decoding of legacy schedule format with atMs.

methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of 'every' schedule with an anchor.

methods.name: `schedule cron encodes and decodes with timezone`
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of cron expression schedules with timezone.

methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of agent turn payloads.
